Adapt a component's result into an orchestra manifest

Source: R/emitters.R
as_orchestra_manifest.Rd

The emitter generic. A component that produces its own result type gains contract membership by having a method registered here, which lifts that type into an orchestra_manifest without the component itself changing.

Usage

as_orchestra_manifest(x, ...)

Arguments

x

The component result to adapt.

...

Arguments passed to the method. See manifest_from_pesto() and manifest_from_gmm() for the two that ship here.

Value

An orchestra_manifest.

Details

Two methods ship with this package, for a PESTO ensemble manifest and a proxymix mixture fit, and each is registered only when its component is installed. The equivalent plain functions are manifest_from_pesto() and manifest_from_gmm().

See also

manifest_from_pesto(), manifest_from_gmm().

Author

Max Moldovan

Examples

# Dispatch requires an installed component that carries a method.
if (requireNamespace("proxymix", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(class(as_orchestra_manifest))
}
#> [1] "S7_generic" "function"   "S7_object"
